performance.verdict: Meta efficient but Google dead weight; SOW gaps now cash-risk.

findings.text: channel_dark:meta — Meta spend shows $0 on Sep 12–13 (2 consecutive zero days); 5 prior zero-spend days cluster on weekends, pattern is probable campaign schedule not reporting gap.

5 overdue SOW milestones (oldest Jul 20): Becklar billing, BWS duplicate check, paid landing pages, UGC batch, and end-to-end stack re-test remain unverified — each a live cash-leak or scaling blocker.
Google Ads spent $508.73 over 28 days with 0 conversions and only 115 clicks; 3-day signal (Sep 11–13: $14.84/$10.83/$10.72 spend, 0 leads) confirms sustained zero output — not noise.
3-day Meta lead signal (Sep 11–13): 4/0/0 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 8–10): 10/12/6 — a 73% volume drop while meta_spend held ~$65–$81/day; likely weekend schedule kill cutting active days.
GHL shows 133 opportunities created vs 138 leads, 0 won, 0 appointments — pipeline intake is absorbing leads but zero progression; not an ads problem, it is a CRM/sales follow-up gap.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads immediately; redirect ~$18/day to Meta — 0 conversions on $508.73 over 28 days is confirmed dead spend.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has produced 0 conversions on $508.73 spend over the past 28 days (115 clicks, no leads), confirmed across the full series with zero output in the last 3 days ($14.84, $10.83, $10.72). Pause all Google Ads campaigns and redirect the ~$18/day daily equivalent to the active Meta campaign. Success check: Meta CPL remains at or below the $15.80 28-day baseline after 7 days (by 2026-09-21).

suggestions.text: Audit Meta campaign schedule — weekend zero-spend days (6 instances in 45 days) are suppressing weekly lead volume by ~30%.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend dropped to $0 on at least 6 days across the 45-day series, consistently on weekends, causing lead volume to fall to 0 on those days. Review the campaign dayparting or budget pacing settings in Meta Ads Manager and confirm ads are either running 7 days or that weekend pausing is intentional and documented. Success check: no unintended $0 spend days in the following 7-day window (verify by 2026-09-21).

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; Becklar billing and BWS duplicate check are ⛔ scale blockers unresolved since Aug 31.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are overdue, the oldest since July 20 (Stripe Products QA) and four since August 31 — including the ⛔ Becklar billing verification and ⛔ BWS duplicate check that directly risk cash leakage on every live order. Escalate to Nacer to assign owners and completion dates for each item this week. Success check: all five milestones marked complete in Monday with evidence (loom, screenshot, or test-order confirmation) by 2026-09-21.
